rules.name: File format
rules.why: GLB is one file with everything inside, the easiest to host.

rules.name: File size
rules.why: Pages load fast when models stay under 5 MB.

rules.name: Texture size
rules.why: Textures over 2048 px slow down phones.

rules.name: Draco compression
rules.why: Draco makes mesh data much smaller to download.

rules.name: One material
rules.why: One material means fewer draw calls.
rules.quote: There is only one material assigned to the model, unless otherwise necessary.

rules.name: Origin at the base
rules.why: Viewers place the model on the ground at its origin.
rules.quote: The base of the model has been placed at the origin of the grid.
